blocks.header: **C-1094** Phil Lyman told Alex Jones he was outside at the east end, heard a loud boom, encountered two girls "very goth, very black" who did not flee, and quoted one as saying "Go f yourselves."
blocks.label: Phil Lyman told Alex Jones he was outside at the east end, heard a loud boom, encountered two girls "very goth, very black" who did not flee, and quoted one as saying "Go f yourselves."

lines.v: In a clip the host plays of his Alex Jones appearance, Phil Lyman says he was outside at the east end when he heard a loud boom and encountered two girls, "very goth, very black," who did not flee, one of whom he quotes as saying "Go f yourselves"; the host says this is consistent with him painting a picture that he was outside when the shot rang out.

Compare Phil's Alex Jones account verbatim against (a) the NewsNation account (C-1099) and (b) the 12:23 video metadata (A-1185.1) to characterize the discrepancy as edit, memory, or misrepresentation.

blocks.header: **C-1099** Phil Lyman told NewsNation he was walking into a building when he heard a loud bang behind him, then ran out to investigate.
blocks.label: Phil Lyman told NewsNation he was walking into a building when he heard a loud bang behind him, then ran out to investigate.

lines.v: In a NewsNation clip the host plays, Phil Lyman says he was walking into a building when he heard a loud bang behind him, then ran out to investigate; the host says this places him approaching or inside a building at the moment of the shot, then exiting.
Cross-reference timestamp of "ran out" with the 12:23 video metadata (A-1185.1) to determine whether Phil was inside or approaching at the moment of the shot.

blocks.header: **C-1100** Video metadata timestamp shows Phil Lyman inside the Sorensen Center at 12:23 on the day of the shooting, walking out calmly.
blocks.label: Video metadata timestamp shows Phil Lyman inside the Sorensen Center at 12:23 on the day of the shooting, walking out calmly.

lines.v: The host says that, according to the metadata of the footage Phil Lyman sent her, he was inside the Sorensen building at 12:23 and then calmly walked out rather than running.
Obtain original file with full EXIF metadata; forensically confirm capture time, device, and chain of custody.

blocks.header: **C-1101** The two individuals in Phil Lyman's aftermath footage are wearing black clothing but do not display abnormal behavior; the host states one may be a man.
blocks.label: The two individuals in Phil Lyman's aftermath footage are wearing black clothing but do not display abnormal behavior; the host states one may be a man.

lines.v: The host says Phil Lyman's aftermath video shows two individuals simply wearing black (one of whom she thinks is a guy) in what seems a normal conversation; she disputes Phil's Alex Jones characterization of them as "goth" and unfazed.
Compare visible individuals in A-1185.1 with the two companions in the Broderick photo (A-1192.1); determine whether they are the same individuals.

blocks.header: **C-1091** Host Says One of Two Companions in Photo With Shaner Broderick Is Gernot Ohner, via Face-Match to BearingPoint Graz Video
blocks.label: Host Says One of Two Companions in Photo With Shaner Broderick Is Gernot Ohner, via Face-Match to BearingPoint Graz Video

lines.v: The host says her team identified one of the two companions in the photo with Shaner Broderick as Gernot Ohner, whose face she says also matches an individual shown in a BearingPoint company YouTube video introducing software development teams at the Graz office.
Obtain the original Broderick companion photo from prior episode; perform controlled side-by-side facial comparison and reach out to BearingPoint HR to confirm Gernot Ohner's employment dates.

blocks.label: Shaner Broderick previously identified Phil Lyman as his uncle on both Instagram and LinkedIn.
